title: Shoppes at Doral Phase I
address:
10425 NW 41st St
Doral, Florida 33178
United States
description:
Shoppes at Doral Phase I is a suburban retail strip center at 10425 NW 41st St in Doral, anchored by Serranos Supermarket alongside a gas station and a pharmacy. The center also holds bakeries like Pan Pa Ya, casual restaurants serving mostly Venezuelan and Argentinian food, and a mix of local service businesses.

A surface parking lot with multiple vehicle entrances serves the center.
